conservative.requirements: Folklore trained. You or an ally engaged with you attempts an action

success.description: Folklore trained. You or an ally engaged with you attempts an action. An ally with which you are engaged attempts an action, you may play & recharge tokens this card to add {De} to his dice pool as you recall some obscure bit of useful knowledge to aid to his attempt. Special: If you are trained in Education, you may add an additional {De} to the dice pool.
